body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes the export mismatch for `KanbanEnhanced` that was breaking tests and tightens a couple of test assertions to better match the component’s actual UI behavior.

**Changes:**
- Switches `KanbanEnhanced` to be both a named and default export, so `import { KanbanEnhanced }` works alongside existing lazy default imports.
- Updates the card count test to assert the exact `"1 / 3"` display for limited columns instead of brittle `/1|2/` regexes.
- Updates the column-limit warning test to assert against the actual `.text-yellow-500` styling used for the near-limit state (including the `AlertTriangle` icon).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanEnhanced.tsx` | Adds a named `KanbanEnhanced` export while preserving the default export, resolving the test import mismatch without breaking existing lazy-loading usage. |
| `packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/KanbanEnhanced.test.tsx` | Adjusts tests to import the named `KanbanEnhanced` export and aligns assertions with the concrete rendered output for card counts and near-limit warnings. |
